quality.tenant_chunk_tradeoff: The cap intentionally retains at most two of three judged chunks per relevant parent on the selective tenant fixture. Parent recall is unchanged, no foreign tenant is admitted, and the unfiltered semantic/quality controls do not regress. The selective chunk-recall loss is accepted as the declared cap behavior rather than mislabeled as equal chunk coverage.

The largest QPS tradeoff retains 50.8k QPS and 0.310 ms p99 with a 0.1667 parent-recall gain. The largest relative p99 remains 0.127 ms at 114k QPS.
